scope: Native Finder edges in both appearances and automatic live Rounded Corners activation.
approval: Maintainer approved the Golden Gate before/after comparison and requested paired publication.

checks.command: KDE neon 6.8.1 Wayland at 2×: Finder corners on black and white in light and dark. Verified window identity and background samples in the VM captures.

Golden Gate installer_backend.py install --only --rounded-corners: upgraded a stale mapped library in place. The new SHA-256-addressed module was mapped; KWin (1316) and Nautilus (59000) kept their PIDs.
Xvfb, KWin X11 and Nautilus at 2×: changing the legacy GTK sheet to the candidate changed 2,164 edge pixels, with identical center pixels. The straight top edge on black changed from RGB 0 to 47.
Built the candidate shader and Rounded Corners module against KWin 6.6.4 and 6.7.4, and installed the 6.8.1 build in the capture VM.
Focused installer, localization and GTK tests: 48 passed, one skipped. Verified-archive compatibility and Qt corner regressions: five passed.
Tahoe auto schedule: observed dusk and dawn on Wayland with the same five open windows; verified rendered GTK 3 and installer colors and recorded the GTK 4 appearance.
Local wrapper --prepare produced byte-identical shader, theme switcher and installer step with MacGoldenGate wallpaper and launcher preset 2.
Verified the immutable Tahoe release archive, version and checksum and ran Golden Gate wrapper tests.

coverage_limits: Live installer upgrade observed on Wayland. X11 Finder was rendered with the effect loaded. An effect-on/off screenshot comparison alone did not distinguish the shader change. Historical gallery images keep their original provenance.
